title: Pin all actions that are not currently pinned
summary: Pinned unpinned GitHub Actions to specific versions across Power Platform deployment workflows and updated the dependabot configuration to manage these pinned versions.
key_points: BuildPowerPlatform, DeployPowerPlatform, and PullPowerPlatformChanges actions now use pinned versions

Improves supply chain security and consistency of action versions in workflows
